title: Amelia | Romantic Long Dress with V-Neckline and Side Slit
bodyHtml:
A stunning floor-length dress that moves beautifully with every step. The V-neckline and tie-waist create a flattering silhouette, while the soft, fluid skirt with side slit adds effortless grace. In a gorgeous dusty rose shade, this is a versatile piece that takes you from daytime events to evening occasions with ease—no alterations needed.

Why you'll love it

  • V-neckline that's wonderfully flattering, drawing the eye upward with real elegance
  • Adjustable tie waist that skims your curves without clinging, creating beautiful proportions
  • Fluid fabric that drapes beautifully and moves with you all day long
  • Maxi skirt with a side slit for graceful movement and a romantic, ethereal vibe
  • Dusty rose is the perfect versatile neutral—works for weddings, celebrations, or special dinners
  • Hard to find in this quality and style—a real gem for your wardrobe
  • Feels as good as it looks, whether you're at a ceremony in Sydney or an evening event in Melbourne
